name: Back Top
description: A floating button that appears after scrolling and returns to the top of the page.

anatomy.description: Floating circular button fixed near the bottom corner, revealed past the scroll threshold.
Up arrow hidden from assistive technology; the button carries its own accessible label.

dos: Set the threshold to roughly one viewport of scrolling.
Keep it clear of other floating controls like chat widgets.
donts: Don't show it on short pages where it adds noise.
Don't place it inside a nested scroll container it cannot observe.

examples.title: Scroll recovery
examples.description: Appears past the threshold and honors reduced motion when scrolling back up.

examples.title: Custom threshold
examples.description: Lower the threshold on short pages so the control still appears.

guidance.useWhen: Pages grow long enough that returning to the top is tedious.
guidance.avoidWhen: The page is short or has its own scroll container.
guidance.behavior: Appears past the threshold and scrolls smoothly unless reduced motion is preferred.
guidance.responsive: The floating position clears content on all viewport sizes.

keyboard.action: Reaches the button once it appears past the scroll threshold.
Scrolls the page back to the top.

notes: Rendered as an IconButton with a required label; the arrow icon is aria-hidden.
Smooth scrolling is skipped when the user prefers reduced motion.
The button renders nothing below the threshold, so it never appears as a dead control on short pages.

apiEntries.description: Floating button that appears after scrolling down and smoothly returns to the top of the page.

props.description: Scrolled distance in pixels after which the button appears; defaults to 400.
props.name: threshold

props.description: Accessible label for the button; defaults to 'Back to top'.
props.name: label
